segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the 85-seat plan and make sure the start date and billing line up before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 85 seats for now. If adoption is good, we may add another 20 in Q2, but I don’t want those on this first invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. So the initial term would be January 15, 2026 through January 14, 2027, 85 seats, billed annually. The total on the pricing sheet is $41,820 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the onboarding package you mentioned, right? The two admin sessions and the import help?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two 60-minute admin trainings, one end-user enablement session, and up to 10 hours of data import support. If you want the end-user session recorded, we can include that at no extra charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, please. Also, procurement asked about payment terms. Our standard is net 45. Your draft had net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is fine for this order. I’ll put that on the order form so the invoice matches what your AP team expects.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Go-live is the other thing. We need managers using it by February 9. Is that realistic if we sign by next Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If signature is in by December 13, we can do kickoff the week of January 6, data import by January 24, admin training the week after, and have managers live February 9.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline works. Send the order form to me and copy Malik in procurement. If the numbers match what we discussed, I can route it today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the 85-seat annual order with net 45, January 15 start, and the onboarding items listed out. You’ll have it in about an hour.
